changelog:
Face recognition: turn on Detect Faces for a camera, add people on the new Registry page, and their alerts name them.
Faces the recorder doesn't know wait under Unknown Faces, grouped by person, with a suggestion when one looks like someone you added.
The Registry shows how many times each person and vehicle was seen, and each profile lists every sighting.
Each notification rule can set its own push message.
Playback shows each alert's snapshot beside the timeline; click one to jump to it.
A new switch in Settings, Notifications turns off alert pop-ups in the browser.
Erasing all face data or clearing all alerts now asks you to type DELETE first.
The Registry loads much faster, and thumbnails no longer show a broken image after scrolling back.
Drives in USB enclosures show their real serial and model, and DVR channels that refuse ONVIF now show their recording resolution.
API keys can no longer create accounts or credentials, and camera passwords no longer appear in error messages.
Push notifications retry when the phone's notification service briefly fails.
